title: 社会生活论述词汇
goal: 辨认社会生活词汇的语境义；补出符合论述对象的常用短语。

points.label: 辨认社会生活词汇的语境义
补出符合论述对象的常用短语

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 论述社会生活时，先分清评价的是哪一方面。convenience 指使用方便。efficiency 指投入的时间或资源与产出之比。fairness 指规则和待遇是否公平。privacy 指个人信息和私人生活不被随意公开。

body.box: A service may be convenient to reach without being efficient to operate. Equal rules do not justify exposing private information.

body.p: 一种好处不能代替另一种。方便的服务不一定高效，也不一定保护隐私。工作选择中，income 指收入，job satisfaction 指对工作的满意程度。资源使用中，reuse 是把物品再次使用，recycling 是把材料加工后再利用。

cards.title: 词汇表：公共责任
rows: Residents share responsibility for common areas.
Decisions about public space should consider the public interest.
Respect for shared facilities can be viewed as a civic duty.
Accountability requires officials to explain their decisions.
Publishing the selection criteria improves transparency.
Fairness requires consistent treatment of comparable cases.
The service aims to provide equal access to essential information.
Public participation brings different concerns into discussion.
Mutual respect allows disagreement without personal attacks.
Voluntary service contributes time to community activities.
cards.note: 公开评选标准，不需要公开个人信息：Transparency about criteria can coexist with privacy protection.

cards.title: 词汇表：数字交流
rows: Digital communication allows messages to reach distant participants.
An online option offers the convenience of submitting from home.
Reducing repeated data entry can improve efficiency.
Personal messages require protection of privacy.
The form collects personal data for a stated purpose.
Informed consent requires an explanation of the proposed use.
Data protection includes limiting access to personal records.
Online interaction can continue after a meeting ends.
Checking the source can help identify misinformation.
Digital literacy includes evaluating information found online.
cards.note: 方便的服务不一定高效：Home submission is convenient, but repeated verification may still take time.

cards.title: 词汇表：工作选择
rows: A career choice involves weighing several priorities.
A long contract may offer greater job security.
Meaningful tasks can contribute to job satisfaction.
Predictable hours can support work-life balance.
Flexible working may allow some control over working hours.
The workload should be considered alongside the salary.
The role requires a relevant qualification.
A new position creates an employment opportunity.
A household may rely on more than one source of income.
cards.note: 收入高，满意度不一定高：A higher income does not guarantee greater job satisfaction.

cards.title: 词汇表：资源节约
rows: Resource conservation includes avoiding unnecessary material use.
Insulation can reduce energy consumption for heating.
Containers can be cleaned for reuse.
Recycling turns suitable discarded materials into usable material.
Durability affects how often an item needs replacement.
Regular maintenance can extend an item’s useful life.
Shared use allows several households to use one appliance.
Resource allocation determines who receives limited supplies.
Sustainable consumption considers resource use over time.
cards.note: reuse 是原物再用，recycling 是材料再加工：A refilled jar is reused; crushed glass may be recycled.

body.box: An online neighborhood discussion can offer convenience because residents can contribute without traveling to a meeting. That benefit does not establish efficiency: moderators may still spend considerable time sorting repeated messages. Fairness concerns whether different residents have a reasonable opportunity to express their views, including those who cannot use the online channel easily. Privacy raises another question: whether names and personal contact details are exposed unnecessarily. A useful evaluation must therefore identify which benefit is supported and which concern remains unresolved.

body.p: without traveling 说的是 convenience。sorting repeated messages 说的是处理所花的时间，属于 efficiency。表达意见的机会属于 fairness，联系方式是否外露属于 privacy。讨论在线上进行很方便，但其余三项不会因此都得到改善。

body.box: A group of households is considering the shared use of a washing machine. Keeping the machine nearby would offer convenience, while using less energy for the same quantity of laundry would indicate greater efficiency. A fair allocation of washing times would address access, not necessarily energy use. Publishing each household’s contact details would raise a separate privacy concern. Maintenance and durability also matter because frequent replacement could undermine the aim of resource conservation. The benefits depend on different features of the arrangement.

body.p: 同样的洗衣量用电更少，说明效率高。洗衣时段分配得当，说明公平。maintenance 和 durability 决定洗衣机能用多久。机器经常更换，共同使用也达不到节约资源的目的。

items.stem: Residents can submit a comment without leaving home, although processing it still takes the same staff time. Which benefit is directly established?
items.why: 依据：without leaving home 说明居民提交方便。processing it still takes the same staff time 说明处理效率没有变化，第二项不成立。

items.stem: A service processes the same number of requests with less repeated data entry. Which concept is most directly involved?
items.why: 依据：the same number of requests with less repeated data entry。产出不变、投入减少，属于效率。第三项沿用了 data 一词，但题干没有讲数据保护。

items.stem: An organizer explains how participants’ contact details will be used before asking permission. Which concept fits?
items.why: 依据：explains how participants’ contact details will be used before asking permission。先说明用途、再征得同意，就是知情同意。

items.stem: Choose the pair: The policy provides equal access ___ information while limiting disclosure ___ personal data.
items.why: 固定搭配是 access to 和 disclosure of。第一项把两个介词放反了。

items.stem: A worker values a reliable long-term contract more than a brief increase in pay. Which priority is emphasized?
items.why: 依据：a reliable long-term contract more than a brief increase in pay。看重长期合同，对应工作稳定性。第二项 income 正是这名员工放在次要位置的东西。

items.stem: A glass jar is cleaned and filled again without being broken down into material. Which term describes this?
items.why: 依据：cleaned and filled again without being broken down into material。原物再次使用，没有加工成新材料，属于 reuse。

items.stem: Residents ask decision makers to explain how public funds were used. Which concept is emphasized?
items.why: 依据：ask decision makers to explain how public funds were used。要求决策者作出解释，对应问责。第二项沿用了资金的话题，但题干没有讲怎样分配。

items.stem: Which phrase concerns the amount of energy used to heat a building?
items.why: 依据：the amount of energy used。用掉的能源量是 energy consumption。第三项 efficiency 讲投入与产出之比，不是用量本身。

items.stem: A worker accepts slightly lower pay because the tasks are more meaningful. Which distinction matters?
options: Income and job satisfaction can differ.
Higher income always means greater satisfaction.
items.why: 依据：accepts slightly lower pay because the tasks are more meaningful。收入低了，满意度反而更高，说明两者可以不同。

items.stem: A discussion permits disagreement but excludes personal attacks. Which principle does this illustrate?
items.why: 依据：permits disagreement but excludes personal attacks。允许分歧、不作人身攻击，对应相互尊重。第一项要求全体同意，与 permits disagreement 不符。

items.stem: Which expression concerns distributing a limited supply among different groups?
items.why: 依据：distributing a limited supply among different groups。在不同群体之间分配有限的物资，就是 resource allocation。

items.stem: A product lasts longer before it needs replacement. Which quality is being described?
items.why: 依据：lasts longer before it needs replacement。产品本身经久耐用，对应 durability。第一项 maintenance 指对物品的维护，题干没有提到。

items.stem: A local consultation offers the same opportunity to comment through paper forms and online messages, so residents without internet access are still included. Which concern is directly addressed?
options: Efficiency measured by staff processing time
Privacy of the contents of personal messages
items.why: 依据：the same opportunity to comment ... residents without internet access are still included。没有网络的居民也有同样的机会，对应参与机会的公平。

items.stem: A photo-sharing group allows members to restrict who can see their family pictures. This control does not change upload speed. Which concept is most directly involved?
items.why: 依据：restrict who can see their family pictures。控制谁能看到家庭照片，属于隐私。第一项与 This control does not change upload speed 不符。

items.stem: Two jobs offer similar pay, but one gives a worker greater enjoyment of daily tasks. Which term describes the difference emphasized here?
items.why: 依据：similar pay ... greater enjoyment of daily tasks。收入相近，差别在于对日常工作的喜爱，对应工作满意度。第一项与 similar pay 不符。

items.stem: A delivery service completes the same number of trips using less fuel after revising its routes. Which conclusion concerns efficiency rather than convenience alone?
options: The service necessarily reaches every customer at a more convenient time of day.
The service completes more trips each day because its revised routes are shorter.
The service saves fuel because it now does less transport work than before.
The service uses fewer energy resources for an unchanged amount of transport work.
items.why: 依据：the same number of trips using less fuel。工作量不变、燃料减少，说明效率提高。第一项讲送达时间是否方便，题干没有提到。

items.stem: Use access with its required preposition after equal: A public service should provide equal ___ essential information through channels that people with different needs can use.
items.why: equal access to 表平等获取机会，to 后接对象。

items.stem: Use consent with the adjective meaning based on adequate information: The organizer should obtain ___ before publishing participants’ contact details for a purpose explained in advance.
items.why: informed consent 指了解用途之后表示同意。

items.stem: Use energy and consumption to name the amount used: Replacing unnecessary heating with better insulation can reduce ___ while maintaining the same indoor conditions for the occupants.
items.why: heating 和 insulation 说的是能源用量，固定说法是 energy consumption。

items.stem: Use allocation with the noun naming what is distributed: A transparent process for ___ should explain how limited supplies are divided among groups with different needs.
items.why: 依据：how limited supplies are divided among groups。分配有限的物资，就是 resource allocation。
